home.title: Your business at a glance
home.body: This card turns your MunshiPoint payments into today's profit, so you can see how the shop is doing without doing any sums.

mtd_till_date.body: This card turns your MunshiPoint payments into your profit for {month} so far, so you can see how the shop is doing without doing any sums.

active_days.body: This card turns your MunshiPoint payments into profit across the {days} you've recorded, so you can see how the shop is doing without doing any sums.

home.title: Today or the whole month
home.body: Switch between today's profit and {month} so far. We'll remember what you pick.

partial.body: Switch between today's profit and {month} so far. With {days} recorded, today is the fairer number for now.

home.title: Your profit, kept private
home.body: Tap the number or the eye to show or hide it. It follows your wallet balance setting and hides again when you leave the app.

home.title: Your daily streak
home.body: The flame grows each day you check and close your numbers. Tap it to see your streak, set a reminder or pick rest days.

home.title: What needs you now
home.body: This line shows one thing at a time: the most important, like payments to sort or a day you missed.

home.title: How you're trending
home.body: Compares this stretch with the one before. Percentages and arrows stay visible even when amounts are hidden.

home.title: Your next step
home.body: The button takes you straight to what the status line asks for, like reviewing today's payments.

home.title: Tap anywhere else for more
home.body: The rest of the card opens Business overview on the same time frame, with your week, month and where your money went.

variants.wholeCard: Tap the card to get started. Once your numbers come in, it opens Business overview.

home.title: MAI sums it up
home.body: MAI tells you your profit in one line, for the time frame you picked.

partial.body: MAI tells you today's profit and what your {days} add up to this month, in one line.

profit.title: Today's profit, worked out for you
profit.body: We take what came in from sales and subtract stock and expenses, straight from your MunshiPoint payments. No notebook, no sums.

mtd_till_date.title: Your {month} profit, worked out for you
mtd_till_date.body: Your profit for {month} so far, with today's payments included. We take sales and subtract stock and expenses, straight from your MunshiPoint payments.

active_days.title: Profit on the days you've recorded
active_days.body: Your profit across the {days} you've recorded in {month}, with today's payments included. No notebook, no sums.

profit.title: Is the month on track?
profit.body: Your profit so far this month, and how it compares with the same day last month.

mtd_till_date.title: Today and the month's pace
mtd_till_date.body: Today's profit so far, and how {month} compares with the same day last month.

active_days.title: Today and the month's pace
active_days.body: Today's profit so far, and how {month} compares with the same day last month.

partial.title: Your month so far
partial.body: Only {days} recorded this month, so there's nothing fair to compare with yet. Add the days you missed for a true month total.

profit.title: See where it comes from
profit.body: Sales in, stock and expenses out. Every line is built from your payments, so you can check the working.

profit.title: It gets sharper with you
profit.body: It starts as a guess. Sort a few payments or add cash and the accuracy goes up.

profit.title: Tell us what each payment was
profit.body: Only you know if a transfer was a sale, stock or personal money. Tap a category and profit updates instantly. Personal money never counts.

profit.title: Include cash and other banks
profit.body: Sold for cash or paid from another bank? Add it so the profit covers your whole business, not just MunshiPoint.

profit.title: Want the full working?
profit.body: Tap here any time to see exactly how today's profit is calculated.

profit.title: Close your day
profit.body: Submit to lock in today's profit. Your streak grows and the card on Home updates with the new number.

overview.title: Pick your time frame
overview.body: Switch between today, this week and this month. It opens on the time frame you picked on Home, and everything on this page follows the tab.

overview.title: What you kept
overview.body: Your profit for the period after stock and expenses, how it compares with last time, and the sales and spending behind it.

variants.setup: Set up profit once and this card shows what you kept after stock and expenses, for any day, week or month.

overview.title: Fill the gaps
overview.body: Dashed days have no records yet. Add them so your month's profit is the real total.

overview.title: One thing to do next
overview.body: The single step that makes these numbers more complete, like reviewing today or catching up a missed day.

overview.title: Every rupee in and out
overview.body: All the money that moved through your account, including payments still pending. Profit only counts what's business.

overview.title: Run more of your business here
overview.body: Send invoices now. Items and Customers are coming soon: tap one to join the waitlist.

overview.title: See the trend
overview.body: Sales and spending over recent weeks. The shaded gap between the lines is your profit.

variants.setup: Once profit is set up, this shows your sales and spending week by week.

overview.title: Know what changed
overview.body: A plain-language read of your numbers and what moved them. Tap Listen to hear it.

overview.title: Pay yourself safely
overview.body: How much you've taken this month, and how much is safe to take without starving the business.

overview.title: Keep your records complete
overview.body: Each dot is a day. Fill in missed days so your profit and trends stay accurate.

overview.title: See how sure we are
overview.body: Check exactly how profit is worked out and how accurate the estimate is. Reviewing more payments raises it.

overview.title: Keep your streak going
overview.body: Close your numbers each day to grow it. Tap to set a reminder or pick rest days.
